reading_issues: This Propagation Labs chart is a DEPTH-from-surface layout (0 at top, HS 115 at bottom), so all heights were converted as height = 115 - depth. Boundaries (depth cm: 0, 30, 44, 45, 63, 86, 115) and hardness edges were measured from pixels of the embedded 2400x1800 chart image (about +/-0.1 cm). The crust's lower boundary (45 cm depth) is covered by the orange test line, so its thickness (~1 cm) is inferred. The CT13/CT16 failures sit at the base of the crust (interface with the FC below); layer_grain given as FC (layer below). The CT22/CT23 line at 80 cm depth is inside the 3 mm FC layer (63-86 cm depth). Header values for air temperature, aspect, slope, surface grain and blowing snow are '?' (null). No temperature profile on chart.
